user.title: Meowant SC10 Litter Box
user.description: Enter the credentials from your Tuya IoT Platform cloud project. These are needed even for local control, because they are how the device's local key is obtained.

data_description.access_id: Your cloud project's Access ID, sometimes shown as Client ID.
data_description.data_center: The region your Smart Life account is registered in. The wrong one will fail to authenticate.
data_description.mode: Local control talks to the device directly over your network: it is faster, keeps working without internet, and uses no API quota. Cloud control works from anywhere but polls every 30 seconds.

device.title: Choose your litter box
device.description: These are the devices linked to your cloud project.

local.title: Local connection
local.description: The local key was read from your cloud project. The address below was found by scanning your network; correct it if it is wrong or blank.

data_description.host: The device's address on your local network. Give it a static lease on your router, or this will break when the address changes.
data_description.local_key: Read from the cloud automatically. It changes if the device is re-paired in the vendor app.
data_description.protocol_version: 3.5 for recent devices. Try 3.3 or 3.4 if the connection fails.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Tuya API. Check your network and the selected data center.
error.invalid_auth: Tuya rejected these credentials. Check the Access ID and Access Secret, and that the data center matches your account.
error.no_devices: No devices found in this cloud project. Link your Smart Life account on the Devices tab of the Tuya IoT Platform.
error.cannot_connect_local: Could not reach the device on your network. Check the IP address, and try a different protocol version.
error.tinytuya_missing: The tinytuya library is not available. Restart Home Assistant and try again.

abort.already_configured: This litter box is already set up.
